import pandas as pd
import numpy as np

# Get recent performance (doy 100-121)
trips = tables['trips']
s6 = trips[trips['fished_date_season'] == 6].copy()

# Recent performance by class and doy
recent = s6[s6['fished_date_doy'].between(100, 121)].copy()
class_perf = recent.groupby('cls').agg({
    'yt': 'sum',
    'anglers': 'sum',
    'cls': 'count'
}).rename(columns={'cls': 'trips'})
class_perf['yt_per_angler'] = class_perf['yt'] / class_perf['anglers']
print("=== Recent Performance by Class (doy 100-121) ===")
print(class_perf.sort_values('yt_per_angler', ascending=False))

# Day-by-day pattern to see if signal holding
print("\n=== Day-by-Day Pattern (doy 100-121) ===")
daily = recent.groupby('fished_date_doy').agg({
    'yt': 'sum',
    'anglers': 'sum'
}).reset_index()
daily['yt_per_angler'] = daily['yt'] / daily['anglers']
daily = daily.sort_values('fished_date_doy')
print(daily.to_string())

import pandas as pd

# Look ahead at September/October (doy 240-305) historical pattern in S6
trips = tables['trips']
s6 = trips[trips['fished_date_season'] == 6].copy()

# We're at doy 121; let's look at available doy 122-180 data (June-early July)
june_early_july = s6[s6['fished_date_doy'].between(122, 180)].copy()
print("=== Forecast Visibility: June-Early July (doy 122-180, ~40 days ahead) ===")
if len(june_early_july) > 0:
    class_perf_ahead = june_early_july.groupby('cls').agg({
        'yt': 'sum',
        'anglers': 'sum',
        'cls': 'count'
    }).rename(columns={'cls': 'trips'})
    class_perf_ahead['yt_per_angler'] = class_perf_ahead['yt'] / class_perf_ahead['anglers']
    print(class_perf_ahead.sort_values('yt_per_angler', ascending=False))
    print(f"Total visibility: {len(june_early_july)} trips available as of now")
else:
    print("No data yet for June-early July (will be available as we approach those dates)")

# Historical September/October from PRIOR SEASONS (S1-S5) for reference
print("\n=== Historical September/October Pattern (S1-S5) ===")
prior_seasons = s6[s6['fished_date_season'] < 6].copy()

        'yt': 'sum',
        'anglers': 'sum',
        'cls': 'count'
    }).rename(columns={'cls': 'trips'})
    class_perf_hist['yt_per_angler'] = class_perf_hist['yt'] / class_perf_hist['anglers']
